annotationPolicy: Supervisor-authored provisional labels fixed before arm outputs, not human-verified ground truth. Sparse exact spans, no coverage claim for unlabeled text. A requirement is explicitly requested product behavior; past execution/process reports are non-requirements; competing suggestions, descriptions of changes, and underspecified references are ambiguous. Code fences and HTML templates are non-requirement source roles, not evidence that code behavior is correct. Public corpus is a convenience sample, not representative. PR titles may be ineligible under baseline source policy; do not attribute those misses to semantic quality.

5776: fix: selectively re-enable SIMD for ppc64
WASM SIMD was disabled by default for all ppc64 due to a bug in V8 on Power >= 9. The fix went into Node.js 25.0.0 and 24.12.0.
Re-enable SIMD by default for ppc64, and only disable when running on the older unpatched versions of Node.js.
